column1: # Official harvest opening per sub-region: the earliest commune opening for any grape in the Comité
# Champagne's yearly table of opening dates by commune and grape (the ban des vendanges)
# copies of the full table published by the Champagne press. Sub-region by commune: Montagne de
# Reims the Grande and Petite Montagne; Vallée de la Marne the Marne valley
# Seine-et-Marne; Côte des Blancs Chouilly to Vertus; Côte des Bar the Aube (less Montgueux and
# Villenauxe-la-Grande). Kept by hand; champagne_must.py lets these win over the Champagne-wide
# start. 2021 has no Aisne communes. Researched 5 October 2026.
